metadata.file_name: 40. Kim et al. (2024). Exploring Influencing Factors at Student and Teacher:School levels on Science Self-efficacy Using Machine Learning and Multilevel Latent Profile Analysis.pdf
metadata.title: Exploring Influencing Factors at Student and Teacher/School levels on Science Self-efficacy Using Machine Learning and Multilevel Latent Profile Analysis

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used WLE scores, which do not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Recorded evidence does not explicitly establish an unweighted analysis. Original extraction rationale: The study does not mention the application of sampling weights in the analysis of student-level data.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study employed multilevel latent profile analysis, which accounts for the hierarchical structure of the data.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed only internal validation through various regression algorithms without mentioning any external validation.
design_fields._pdf_matched: 40. Kim et al. (2024). Exploring Influencing Factors at Student and Teacher:School levels on Science Self-efficacy Using Machine Learning and Multilevel Latent Profile Analysis.pdf
design_fields.q4b_note: LLM (gpt-5.4-nano): “PISA 2015 Science data for five high-performing countries (SGP, JPN, EST, FIN, KOR)… compare 20+ regression algorithms… best… Light Gradient Boosting (RMSE=0.960, R²=0.356)”
design_fields._q2_audit: Corrected not_met to not_reported because original rationale reports absence of weight information or an inference, not direct evidence of unweighted analysis; source verification still required.
